data.name: Query_WorkOrderCreationReport
data.value:
select WorkOrderCreation_Header.WOC_HeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.DocumentNo , convert ( varchar(15),WorkOrderCreation_Header.DocumentDate ,106 ) DocumentDate ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.CustomerOrderNo , convert ( varchar (15),WorkOrderCreation_Header.CustomerOrderDate,106) CustomerOrderDate ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.FaxNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.ReferenceNo ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.Quantity as HeaderQty ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.Rate as HeaderRate ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.OtherInstruction as HeaderInstruction ,INV_Item.Description ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,SET_City.CityName +', '+ AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode +', '+ AR_SET_Customer.ExtensionNumber as CustomerAddress ,WorkOrderCreation_Detail.OtherInstruction ,set_operatingunit.AddressLine1 ,set_operatingunit.AddressLine2 ,set_operatingunit.AddressLine3 ,HeaderItem.Description as HeaderItem , HeaderItem.ItemID as HeaderItemID ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.Weave ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.BottomStitch ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.Packing ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.UVStablize ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.Denier ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.DispatchPlace ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.ContactPersonName ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.ContactPersonNo ,WorkOrderCreation_Header.Length as HeaderLength, WorkOrderCreation_Header.Width as HeaderWidth, WorkOrderCreation_Header.Color as HeaderColor, WorkOrderCreation_Header.Weight as HeaderWeight ,INV_Item.Color, INV_Item.Width, INV_Item.Length, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Type, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Width as DetailWidth, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Length as DetailLength, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Weight as DetailWeight, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Side, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Color as DetailColor, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Stereo, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Colors as DetailColors, WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Samples,WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Apperance ,WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Thickness ,WorkOrderCreation_Detail.SeamMargin from WorkOrderCreation_Header inner join WorkOrderCreation_Detail on WorkOrderCreation_Detail.WOC_HeaderID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.WOC_HeaderID and WorkOrderCreation_Detail.CompanyID= WorkOrderCreation_Header.CompanyID and WorkOrderCreation_Detail.Status = 1 and WorkOrderCreation_Header.Status = 1 left join INV_Item HeaderItem on HeaderItem.ItemID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.ItemID --and HeaderItem.CompanyID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.CompanyID and HeaderItem.status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID= WorkOrderCreation_Header.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = WorkOrderCreation_Detail.ItemID -- and INV_Item.CompanyID = WorkOrderCreation_Detail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
inner join Inv_set_category on Inv_set_category.CategoryID= WorkOrderCreation_Detail.CategoryID --and Inv_set_category.CompanyID = WorkOrderCreation_Detail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1 inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.CompanyID and SET_Company.Status =1
inner join set_operatingunit on set_operatingunit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId and set_operatingunit.status = 1
left join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID and SET_City.Status = 1 where WorkOrderCreation_Header.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} ------------------ select WorkOrderCreation_Header.DocumentNo,WorkOrder_DeliverySchedule.DateMonth,WorkOrder_DeliverySchedule.Quantity from WorkOrderCreation_Header
inner join WorkOrder_DeliverySchedule on WorkOrder_DeliverySchedule.WOC_HeaderID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.WOC_HeaderID and WorkOrder_DeliverySchedule.CompanyID = WorkOrderCreation_Header.CompanyID and WorkOrder_DeliverySchedule.Status = 1 and WorkOrderCreation_Header.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0}
